identity_cost.detail: email: the sign-in page offers an email address and a password ('EmailPassword') with a Sign Up tab, beside Google and SSO ('Sign in with Google'; 'Sign in with SSO'). A card is not required for the free allowance: the terms state 'Some Services are free; others require payment (“Paid Services”).' and charge a payment method only when Paid Services are bought ('You authorize us (via our payment processor – currently Stripe) to charge your chosen payment method.'). A phone is not required: the sign-in form at https://app.cloudcruise.com/login carries an email address and a password and no phone field. Country: not published at https://cloudcruise.com/terms.
